decision: 10 second time penalty imposed after the race in accordance with Article 38.3 (10 seconds added to elapsed race time). Reason The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video and audio evidence. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that the team instructed the driver to pit. The team could not prove that one of the exemptions made under paragraph A. 2. a) to g) of the Technical Directive 011-17 was applicable. Therefore, the Stewards consider there is breach of Art. 27.1 of the Sporting Regulations, that the driver must drive the car alone and unaided.
